short: Concentrated liquidity AMM with tick-based positions and multiple fee tiers
introduction: Uniswap V3 introduced concentrated liquidity, allowing liquidity providers to allocate capital within specific price ranges rather than across the entire price curve. This dramatically improves capital efficiency compared to V2, as LPs can concentrate their funds where trading actually occurs. Each position is represented as a unique NFT, and the protocol supports multiple fee tiers (0.01%, 0.05%, 0.3%, 1%) per token pair.
designPurpose: Uniswap V3 was designed to solve the capital inefficiency of constant-product AMMs where the majority of deposited liquidity sits idle at extreme prices. By enabling range-based positions, LPs can earn significantly higher returns on their capital. The tick-based architecture and multiple fee tiers allow the market to create highly efficient, customized liquidity profiles for different asset types.
commonUsage: Traders swap tokens through V3 pools to benefit from deeper liquidity and tighter spreads. Liquidity providers create concentrated positions around the current price to maximize fee income, actively managing their ranges as prices move. The built-in TWAP oracle is used by other protocols for manipulation-resistant price data.
fn.exactInputSingle.desc: Swaps an exact amount of one token for as much as possible of another token through a single pool, specified by the fee tier.
fn.exactInputSingle.params.tokenIn: The address of the token being sold.
fn.exactInputSingle.params.tokenOut: The address of the token being bought.
fn.exactInputSingle.params.fee: The fee tier of the pool to swap through (e.g., 500 for 0.05%, 3000 for 0.3%, 10000 for 1%).
fn.exactInputSingle.params.recipient: The address to receive the output tokens.
fn.exactInputSingle.params.amountIn: The exact amount of input tokens to swap.
fn.exactInputSingle.params.amountOutMini: The minimum output tokens to receive (slippage protection).
fn.exactInputSingle.params.sqrtPriceLimi: The price limit for the swap in sqrt(price) Q96 format. Use 0 for no limit.
fn.exactInputSingle.returns.amountOut: The actual amount of output tokens received.
fn.exactInput.desc: Swaps an exact input amount through a multi-hop path of pools, encoded as a sequence of token addresses and fee tiers.
fn.exactInput.params.path: The encoded swap path: tokenIn + fee + tokenMid + fee + tokenOut (packed bytes).
fn.exactInput.params.recipient: The address to receive the final output tokens.
fn.exactInput.params.amountIn: The exact amount of input tokens for the first swap.
fn.exactInput.params.amountOutMinimum: The minimum final output tokens to receive.
fn.exactInput.returns.amountOut: The actual amount of final output tokens received.
fn.mint.desc: Creates a new concentrated liquidity position as an NFT. Deposits tokens into the pool within the specified tick range and mints a position NFT to the recipient.
fn.mint.params.token0: The address of the pool's token0.
fn.mint.params.token1: The address of the pool's token1.
fn.mint.params.fee: The fee tier of the pool.
fn.mint.params.tickLower: The lower tick boundary of the position's price range.
fn.mint.params.tickUpper: The upper tick boundary of the position's price range.
fn.mint.params.amount0Desired: The desired amount of token0 to deposit.
fn.mint.params.amount1Desired: The desired amount of token1 to deposit.
fn.mint.params.amount0Min: The minimum amount of token0 to deposit (slippage protection).
fn.mint.params.amount1Min: The minimum amount of token1 to deposit (slippage protection).
fn.mint.params.recipient: The address that will own the minted position NFT.
fn.mint.returns.tokenId: The unique token ID of the minted position NFT.
fn.mint.returns.liquidity: The amount of liquidity added to the position.
fn.mint.returns.amount0: The actual amount of token0 deposited.
fn.mint.returns.amount1: The actual amount of token1 deposited.
fn.collect.desc: Collects accumulated trading fees earned by a liquidity position. Fees accrue in both tokens as swaps cross the position's tick range.
fn.collect.params.tokenId: The token ID of the position to collect fees from.
fn.collect.params.recipient: The address to receive the collected fees.
fn.collect.params.amount0Max: The maximum amount of token0 fees to collect.
fn.collect.params.amount1Max: The maximum amount of token1 fees to collect.
fn.collect.returns.amount0: The actual amount of token0 fees collected.
fn.collect.returns.amount1: The actual amount of token1 fees collected.
fn.burn.desc: Burns a position NFT after all liquidity has been removed and fees collected. The position must have zero liquidity and zero uncollected fees.
fn.burn.params.tokenId: The token ID of the position NFT to burn.
fn.burn.returns.amount0: The amount of token0 returned (should be 0 if fully collected).
fn.burn.returns.amount1: The amount of token1 returned (should be 0 if fully collected).
fn.swap.desc: The core pool-level swap function. Executes a swap within a single pool, crossing ticks as needed and calling back the sender for payment.
fn.swap.params.recipient: The address to receive the output tokens.
fn.swap.params.zeroForOne: True to swap token0 for token1, false for token1 to token0.
fn.swap.params.amountSpecified: The amount to swap. Positive for exact input, negative for exact output.
fn.swap.params.sqrtPriceLimitX96: The price limit in sqrtPriceX96 format. The swap stops when this price is reached.
fn.swap.params.data: Callback data passed to the uniswapV3SwapCallback function.
fn.swap.returns.amount0: The delta of token0 (negative means the pool sent tokens out).
fn.swap.returns.amount1: The delta of token1 (negative means the pool sent tokens out).
fn.Swap.desc: Emitted on every swap in the pool, recording the amounts, new price, liquidity, and current tick.
fn.Swap.params.sender: The address that initiated the swap.
fn.Swap.params.recipient: The address that received the output tokens.
fn.Swap.params.amount0: The delta of token0 in the pool.
fn.Swap.params.amount1: The delta of token1 in the pool.
fn.Swap.params.sqrtPriceX96: The new sqrt price of the pool after the swap.
fn.Swap.params.liquidity: The active liquidity in the pool during the swap.
fn.Swap.params.tick: The current tick after the swap.
sim.concentratedLiquiditySwap.name: Concentrated Liquidity Swap
sim.concentratedLiquiditySwap.desc: Simulates a swap through a Uniswap V3 pool, showing how the concentrated liquidity tick system and fee tiers work together.
sim.concentratedLiquiditySwap.step.callR: The trader calls exactInputSingle() on the Swap Router, specifying the token pair, fee tier, and minimum output amount.
sim.concentratedLiquiditySwap.step.poolS: The Router forwards the swap to the V3 Pool, which traverses active tick ranges to fill the order. Only liquidity within range participates.
sim.concentratedLiquiditySwap.step.oracl: The pool updates its built-in TWAP oracle with a new cumulative price observation after the swap.
sim.concentratedLiquiditySwap.step.recei: The output tokens are transferred to the trader. The fee tier (e.g., 0.3%) is deducted and distributed to in-range liquidity providers.
sim.provideConcentratedLiquidity.name: Provide Concentrated Liquidity
sim.provideConcentratedLiquidity.desc: Simulates providing concentrated liquidity within a custom tick range, demonstrating how V3 positions work as NFTs.
sim.provideConcentratedLiquidity.step.ap: The liquidity provider approves the NonfungiblePositionManager to spend both tokens.
sim.provideConcentratedLiquidity.step.mi: The provider calls mint() on the NonfungiblePositionManager, specifying the tick range. A unique NFT representing the position is minted.
sim.provideConcentratedLiquidity.step.up: The pool updates the tick bitmap and liquidity for the specified range. Both tokens are deposited proportionally based on the current price relative to the range.
